prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 9:16 vertical cinematic professional lifestyle portrait of an original adult woman with loose honey-blonde waves, soft subtle smile, and minimal natural makeup. She wears a light beige linen pinafore midi dress over a cream short-sleeve blouse and plain closed-toe tan flats. Seat her sideways on a rustic wood bench with torso gently toward camera, holding a bouquet of eucalyptus and small white flowers. Set her at the brick-paved entrance of a cozy unbranded botanical boutique, with lush plants, flowers, dark vases, and warm pendant-light bokeh behind blank glass. Use soft diffused daylight, warm interior glow, eye-level medium framing, shallow depth, natural skin, detailed linen/foliage, realistic hands, and gentle bokeh. No celebrity likeness, shop name, signs, product labels, logos, text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, named person, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, backless apron, bare feet, logo, readable shop sign, text, watermark, distorted hands, AI artifacts
